lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating visible anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges running along the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior edge to lower intensity shadow on the inferior edge.
